how_to_run: Manual. Give each prompt to a fresh session twice, with and without the skill, on a branch from main. Grade every expectation pass or fail from the transcript and the diff, not from the summary. A skill change is kept when it raises passes without new failures; record the table in the PR.

evals.prompt: Каменные фонари во дворе стоят не по плоскости пола, перерисуй их.
evals.expected_output: A regenerated lantern sheet whose bases measure on the 2:1 floor, heights derived from the cells they stand on, an in-game crop next to the board and a GUT geometry test that fails on the old atlas.
expectations: Writes acceptance criteria from the complaint before editing, including the base slope 0.5 +- 0.06
Generates over tools/art/iso_template.py with the template as the first image and the slope stated in numbers
Runs tools/art/measure_base.py with --check on the new master and regenerates until exit 0, never stretches the image
Derives height_px from the footprint against the cell diamond, then reports the height in hero heights
Captures the arena in game (capture_run grid) and shows the crop next to the reference board
Adds or extends a GUT test over the atlas alpha and shows that the previous atlas fails it

evals.prompt: Добавь герою клип получения удара по всем направлениям.
evals.expected_output: A hit clip in the hero anim_atlas built from one imagegen sheet per drawn direction with the model sheet attached, passing the ANIM_* thresholds, wired to the simulation event and checked on a contact sheet.
expectations: Attaches the model sheet and the main board to every generation request
Decides which directions are drawn and which are mirrored, and records it in source.json
Generates one sheet per clip and direction and records the chosen candidate number for each
validate_assets passes with the loop seam, height spread and torso drift reported in the PR
Ties the clip to a simulation event and adds a GUT test that the event plays it once
Captures the capture_run hero contact sheet and checks identity and common rhythm across directions

evals.prompt: Волк при беге скользит ногами по полу.
evals.expected_output: A measured stride against the wolf's on-screen speed, a fps change in source.json (not a simulation speed change), a rebuilt atlas and a contact sheet that shows the planted foot holding its place.
expectations: Computes the expected foot travel per half cycle from the on-screen speed, frame count and fps
Changes the clip fps in source.json or regenerates the sheet, and leaves the simulation speed untouched
Rebuilds with tools/art/build_sprites.py and passes scripts/validate_assets.py
Shows a contact sheet or an in-game sequence where the planted foot does not slide
Adds the case to the skill's 'Уже случалось' if it was a new kind of defect
